description: First frozen suite: five goal scenarios plus a full-game track.

controllers.scripted: per-scenario scripted baseline named by each manifest's `baseline`
controllers.model: model controller with an experiment configuration

analysis.success_rate: successes / valid completed episodes; 95% percentile bootstrap clustered by seed, 2000 resamples, fixed resampling seed
analysis.time_to_success: achieved_turn of successful episodes; failures censored at the horizon; medians reported only with the censored count
analysis.full_game: wins, draws, losses, administrative outcomes; match score (wins + 0.5 draws) / valid matches
analysis.exclusions: failed, invalid, interrupted, and incomplete episodes are excluded from denominators and listed with reasons
analysis.cost: provider-reported cost when available, otherwise configured prices; unavailable counts stay unavailable
